newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's cenbank offers 45 mln soles of 42-day CDs.
newsitem.headline: Peru's cenbank offers 45 mln soles of 42-day CDs.

text.p: The Central Reserve Bank of Peru said Tuesday it would accept bids for 42-day Certificates of Deposit (CDs) worth 45.0 million soles until 1430 local time (2:30 p.m./EDT/1930 GMT) BCQY.
All the certificates have a September 18 starting date.
The average effective annual interest rate for the certificates, which will be announced after the auction, is used as an informal indicator for interest rates in the Peruvian financial system.
